Thanks for the tag. Quick triage notes from the runtime team after reproducing locally against the Coupa invite flow:
- The vendor landing page includes a third-party consent iframe (privacy tools vendor) that renders a sticky banner with a z-index above our accept CTA in a subset of browsers when certain cookies are blocked.
- We grabbed console logs while repro-ing (attached). The page does receive our invite token correctly but the click handler is not reachable due to the overlay layer.

Immediate remediation options:
1) Re-issue an invite with a one-click activation link that bypasses the interstitial (safe for single-use, expires in 48h).
2) Provide a short JS snippet the vendor can paste in the console to hide the banner (not ideal for security/comms).
3) Ask Vendor IT to accept via incognito/clearing cookies — lowest friction but may be unreliable.

I recommend option 1 for production vendor onboarding. Marissa, if you approve, I can generate the direct activation link and reopen the invite. I'll also file INF-4912 to track a more permanent UX-safe guard (strip vendor overlays on our invite iframe).

Ben
